headline: Restrictive, with a haven bid in Treasuries. Monday's tech rout pulled the 2-year down to 4.83% and the 10-year to 5.12%, but markets still price a December hike as very likely, the dollar made a new 19-month high at 103.6, and oil fell another ~3% (WTI $85.72), now down roughly 18% this month. Keep underwriting to a 10-year above 5% and floating-rate costs 25 bp higher by year-end; softer energy helps operating costs, but risk-off equity markets argue for locking financing before the Dec 9 FOMC rather than waiting for better terms.
